subject: CORRECTION to 774ebe4f: the prompting principles' evidence lines corrected after a fact check (nine overstatements); the Pan_Handlers copy is Ziggy's open question, not a settled route; rehashed
body:
The fact check of the guide found nine places where I stated more than the records show. All corrected; the file supersedes the one attached to 774ebe4f: PROMPTING_PRINCIPLES_v001.md, sha256 5bc87e6c4ed9a8077e80fc35fdd1b2e9b059d0cf008f671bdec35c22942915e6, 12,158 bytes. The ten principles and the skeleton stand; the corrections are to what the evidence lines claim.

1. Wrong: that the background action held across all three Flow takes "when written as its own paragraph". Only take two wrote the background as its own paragraph; SW-2 and take one were single-paragraph prompts. The worm action was present in all three regardless, so the paragraph form is a preference from one take, not a tested cause.
2. Audio: all three silent prompts on Flow returned an audio track, near silent once (Signal take one) and substantial twice (SW-2, peak -7.7 dBFS; Signal take two, peak 0.0 dBFS), not "substantial once".
3. "Only standing there" was my paraphrase, not Ziggy's words; the record's relay says the character was standing there without proper performance motion, as relayed by CFA Nova root; and "the same frame with a job in the hand would not have" was a counterfactual stated as fact, now what rung 1 would test.
4. The image-quality sentence (no shake, no grain, quality stays high) is your labelled interpretation in da73f3bc, not Ziggy's words; attributed so.
5. The mechanism behind "states, not actions" (a transition sentence invites continued motion) is a hypothesis from one result, as the Signal assessment labels it; the guide said it as a finding.
6. "Every over-specified performance came back busier" generalized from one take; now "one result so far", and the two-tell limit is a hypothesis from it.
7. The Flow route note stated the camera-ward hand as a route behaviour; both the side reading and the hand reading are hypotheses from the same single result.
8. The music parallel attributed to DeepSeek's drafts two rules they do not state; they keep mood words beside the sources and give one copy-ready prompt per direction, which is what the guide now says.
9. The Pan_Handlers teaching copy was stated as a settled route while the guide's own open question 5 leaves it to Ziggy; now consistent.

DECISIONS item 57 carries the correction. No running job, scope or budget touched; nothing adopted.

attachments.description: The prompting principles after the fact check (supersedes 3fbeb265…).

source: The one-agent fact check of 2026-10-14 about 05:03 UTC against the prototype records, da73f3bc, the production method, the brief standard and DeepSeek's cue drafts.
